{{lead.First Name:default=Friend}},
Thanks for your interest in our AML & Fraud Toolkit. To ensure the correct people within your institution have access to this resource please consider the following requirements:
1. Your institution is a Flywire client
2. Someone in your institution has:
- Completed the AML & Fraud Foundation <[[https://www.flywire.com/trainings/uk/aml-fraud-foundation]]> training - Joined and regularly attends the quarterly AML Community Meetings <[[https://www.flywire.com/events/meetings]]> - Attended relevant Flywire conference or workshop sessions around AML & Fraud
These steps ensure that we share a common understanding of the key risks and best practices.
Please get in touch with me if you feel you meet the above criteria and I will grant access.
Best wishes
Jo Brewin
Consultant
joanna.brewin@flywire.com Flywire Global Headquarters 141 Tremont Street, Boston, MA 02111 United States
